correctness.rationale: For 0<r<1/2 and 0<a<r the four corner and one central similitudes have strictly positive weights (r-a,a,a,r-a,1-2r), and each x/y marginal strip has probability exactly its length, so unique IFS marginals are Lebesgue and the invariant law defines a copula. The five images satisfy the open-set condition and common full support K_r with Moran dimension root 4r^s+(1-2r)^s=1; continuity and r endpoints reach every 1<s<2. The k-fold bottom-left cylinder has probability (r-a)^k, so nonzero Vandermonde determinants establish continuum linear independence of distinct C_{r,a} without appealing to unverified mutual singularity. For fixed a0, eta>0, the family of copula measures concentrated on closed K_r and dominating eta*mu_{r,a0} is convex and closed in uniform CDF convergence: weak limits preserve K mass and nonnegative measure-order tests; domination plus the full-support mu0 yields exact support K. Anchored D_a=eta*C_{r,a0}+(1-eta)*C_{r,a} retain independence because evaluation at (1,1) cancels the common anchor. Ambient continuous functions have cardinality continuum. The claim matches the stated 2026 Definition 2.5, not impossible closed linear subspace spaceability. Exact rational independent checks verified weights and anchored Vandermonde through five parameters, and Moran roots at r=0.01,.1,.3,.49; the universal statements are proved analytically.
